source: R datasets::airquality; CSV import, missing data, duplicate removal, dates and grouped summaries
code:
raw <- transform(airquality, station = rep(c("Station α", "Station β", "Station γ"), length.out = nrow(airquality)))
write.csv(rbind(raw, raw[1:3, ]), "airquality-raw.csv", row.names = FALSE, fileEncoding = "UTF-8")
imported <- read.csv("airquality-raw.csv", fileEncoding = "UTF-8")
stopifnot(nrow(imported) == 156)
clean <- unique(imported)
clean$date <- as.Date(sprintf("1973-%02d-%02d", clean$Month, clean$Day))
stopifnot(nrow(clean) == 153, sum(is.na(clean$Ozone)) == 37, length(unique(clean$date)) == 153)
missingness <- data.frame(variable = names(clean), missing = colSums(is.na(clean)))
missingness
aggregate(cbind(Temp, Wind) ~ station, clean, mean)
stopifnot(all.equal(clean$Temp, airquality$Temp), all.equal(clean$Wind, airquality$Wind))

source: data.table using built-in iris: grouping, joins, long/wide reshape and Unicode labels
code:
library(data.table)
d <- as.data.table(iris)
d[, id := .I]
lookup <- data.table(Species = unique(d$Species), group_label = c("Group α", "Group β", "Group γ"))
joined <- merge(d, lookup, by = "Species", sort = FALSE)
long <- melt(joined, id.vars = c("id", "Species", "group_label"), variable.name = "measurement")
wide <- dcast(long, id + Species + group_label ~ measurement)
stopifnot(nrow(joined) == 150, nrow(long) == 600, nrow(wide) == 150, !anyNA(wide))
wide
joined[, .(n = .N, mean_sepal = mean(Sepal.Length), sd_sepal = sd(Sepal.Length)), by = Species]

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
summaries <- ChickWeight |>
  group_by(Diet, Time) |>
  summarise(n = n(), mean_weight = mean(weight), se = sd(weight) / sqrt(n()), .groups = "drop")
wide <- summaries |> select(Diet, Time, mean_weight) |> pivot_wider(names_from = Diet, values_from = mean_weight)
stopifnot(nrow(summaries) == 48, nrow(wide) == 12, sum(summaries$n) == nrow(ChickWeight))
summaries
wide

summary(iris)
quantile(mtcars$mpg, probs = c(.025, .25, .5, .75, .975))
tab <- table(mtcars$cyl, mtcars$am)
tab
prop.table(tab, margin = 1)

test

source: stats::lm, summary.lm, anova.lm, confint and predict
code:
fit <- lm(mpg ~ wt + factor(cyl), data = mtcars)
summary(fit)
intervals <- confint(fit)
intervals
anova(fit)
new <- data.frame(wt = c(2, 3, 4), cyl = c(4, 6, 8))
predictions <- cbind(new, predict(fit, new, interval = "prediction"))
predictions
stopifnot(abs(coef(fit)[["wt"]] + 3.205613256) < 1e-7, all(predictions$lwr < predictions$fit), all(predictions$fit < predictions$upr))

source: stats::glm, fitted probabilities, Wald intervals and confusion tables
code:
fit <- glm(am ~ wt + hp, data = mtcars, family = binomial())
summary(fit)
stopifnot(fit$converged, all(fitted(fit) > 0 & fitted(fit) < 1))
exp(cbind(odds_ratio = coef(fit), confint.default(fit)))
classification <- table(observed = mtcars$am, predicted = as.integer(fitted(fit) > .5))
classification
stopifnot(sum(diag(classification)) / sum(classification) > .85)

source: Reproducible bootstrap with intervening Interactive data inspection
code:
set.seed(2026)
expected <- replicate(300, mean(sample(mtcars$mpg, replace = TRUE)))
set.seed(2026)
head(mtcars)
actual <- replicate(300, mean(sample(mtcars$mpg, replace = TRUE)))
stopifnot(identical(expected, actual))
result <- data.frame(estimate = mean(mtcars$mpg), lower = unname(quantile(actual, .025)), upper = unname(quantile(actual, .975)))
result
hist(actual, breaks = 20, main = "Bootstrap means: reproducible after inspection", xlab = "Mean mpg")
abline(v = result[c("lower", "upper")], col = "red", lty = 2)

source: survival::coxph and survival::survfit with built-in lung data
code:
library(survival)
fit <- coxph(Surv(time, status) ~ age + sex, data = lung)
summary(fit)
stopifnot(all(is.finite(coef(fit))))
exp(cbind(hazard_ratio = coef(fit), confint(fit)))
curves <- survfit(Surv(time, status) ~ sex, data = lung)
plot(curves, col = c("steelblue", "tomato"), xlab = "Days", ylab = "Survival probability", main = "Kaplan-Meier survival")
legend("topright", legend = c("Male", "Female"), col = c("steelblue", "tomato"), lty = 1)

source: Base R CSV/gzip/RDS round trips plus SVG/PDF plot export
code:
output <- data.frame(id = sprintf("%04d", 1:3), label = c("α, beta", "line\nbreak", "quote \"value\""), value = c(pi, NA_real_, 1/3))
write.csv(output, "research-results.csv", row.names = FALSE, fileEncoding = "UTF-8")
con <- gzfile("research-results.csv.gz", "wt")
write.csv(output, con, row.names = FALSE)
close(con)
restored <- read.csv("research-results.csv.gz", colClasses = c("character", "character", "numeric"))
stopifnot(identical(output$id, restored$id), identical(output$label, restored$label), isTRUE(all.equal(output$value, restored$value)))
fit <- lm(mpg ~ wt, mtcars)
saveRDS(list(data = output, model = fit, metadata = sessionInfo()), "research-model.rds")
stopifnot(identical(coef(readRDS("research-model.rds")$model), coef(fit)))
pdf("research-model.pdf"); plot(mtcars$wt, mtcars$mpg); abline(fit); dev.off()
svglite::svglite("research-model.svg"); plot(mtcars$wt, mtcars$mpg); abline(fit); dev.off()
stopifnot(all(file.info(c("research-model.pdf", "research-model.svg"))$size > 1000))
output
